detailed_description: Citation Formatter builds a citation string from manually entered source details. Choose APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, or IEEE style, select a source type, and fill in fields such as authors, title, year, publisher, journal, volume, issue, pages, DOI, URL, and access date when relevant. The formatted citation updates on the page and can be copied. It is a lightweight helper, so review the result against your required style guide before submission.
usage_steps: Choose APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, or IEEE style
Select book, journal article, article, or website source type
usage_examples: Draft a book citation from author, title, year, and publisher fields
Create a website citation with URL and access date
Format a journal article with volume, issue, pages, and DOI
